exposure: Vaginal probiotic in combination with standard antibiotic prophylaxis
cohort: The study participants were cases of preterm premature rupture of the membranes (PPROM) between 24 and 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: While there was no significant difference in mean latency period or mean gestational age at birth, the overall neonatal outcome was better in the group receiving vaginal probiotics in addition to standard antibiotic prophylaxis.
